website_summary.name: AI Website Showdown
website_summary.description: The website features a sleek, dark-themed interface with interactive elements designed for users to engage in AI-driven website creation competitions.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a minimalist and modern design with a dark gradient background transitioning from #1e1e2f to #2d2d44. It prominently displays the title "WebDev Arena" in bold white text. Below the title, there's a brief introduction explaining the concept of the site, where AI models compete to build websites based on user prompts. The main interactive area includes a form with a text input field labeled "Create a prompt for your website," accompanied by a placeholder example. A vibrant orange button labeled "Generate Websites" invites users to submit their prompts. The overall layout is centered, ensuring a clean and focused user experience.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to input a prompt describing the desired website characteristics. Upon submission, two AI models, Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4o, generate unique websites based on the given prompt. Users can then compare the generated websites side by side and vote for their preferred version. This voting mechanism determines which AI model performs better according to user preferences.

functionality_testing.name: Generate Websites Button Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Generate Websites Button initiates the website generation process.
functionality_testing.preconditions: A valid prompt is entered in the input field.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The system should start processing the prompt and display a loading indicator.
procedure: Click on the Generate Websites Button.
Verify that a loading indicator appears, indicating the generation process has started.

data_display_testing.name: Error Handling Test
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the application handles errors gracefully and provides useful information for troubleshooting.
data_display_testing.expected_results: The error message is clear and informative, guiding the user on how to proceed or troubleshoot the issue.
procedure: Observe the error message displayed on the screen.
Check the browser console for more detailed information about the error.

data_display_testing.name: WebDev Arena Card Display Test
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the WebDev Arena Card displays accurate and relevant information.
data_display_testing.expected_results: The card displays accurate and relevant information about the platform.
procedure: Hover over the WebDev Arena Card.
Verify that the card displays accurate and relevant information about the platform.

data_display_testing.name: Welcome Card Display Test
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the Welcome Card displays the correct information.
data_display_testing.expected_results: The welcome card displays the correct information about the platform.
